title: SkillFrontmatter
description: Schema for Artibot SKILL.md frontmatter fields. All fields except name and description are optional.

context.description: Skill context type. Use 'fork' for user-accessible skills.

name.description: Unique skill identifier matching the directory name.

description.description: One-paragraph description of when the skill applies and what it does.

whenNotToUse.description: Explicit scope boundaries describing when NOT to activate this skill. 1-2 sentences covering anti-triggers and out-of-scope contexts.

triggers.description: Keywords or phrases for Artibot's own tooling. NOT a host activation field: the host activates a skill from `description` (plus `when_to_use`) and does not read `triggers` — measured 2026-09-11 on claude 2.1.268, where trigger tokens rendered 0 times across 3 runs, and the binary's recognised-key array does not list it (that the array is the COMPLETE set of recognised keys is inference, not measured; the official docs were not read). Consumers are all Artibot tools: scripts/gen-skill-docs.js, scripts/hooks/skill-validation-check.js, lib/core/skill-exporter.js, lib/adapters/adapter-utils.js, lib/sdk/artibot-sdk.js. Vocabulary dropped from `description` is therefore NOT preserved for host activation by moving it here.

agents.description: Agent names this skill delegates to.

category.description: Skill category for grouping and filtering.

platforms.description: Supported platforms: claude-code, gemini-cli, codex-cli, cursor.

source_hash.description: 8-character hex hash of the canonical source used to derive this skill.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill file.

lastVerified.description: ISO date when this skill was last verified against the codebase.

auto-invoke.description: Whether the skill is auto-invoked by the agent chain without user input.

user-invocable.description: Whether the user can explicitly invoke this skill.

allowed-tools.description: Subset of tools this skill is permitted to use.

progressive_disclosure.description: Progressive disclosure configuration for multi-level skills.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown to the user for the $ARGUMENTS placeholder.
